page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre. Page number top left. Main text in one column of paragraph-like annual entries. One marginal note at left, beside the line "M.DC.IIII.", reading "Ann. M.DC.III." (a marginal year note).

main_text.p: Meutenenses in Hochstraten nuntii Apostolici scriptum de pace concerpunt, & à vicinis locis & Ducatibus exactiones cogunt.
Tres milites voluerunt Castellum Cameraci Meutinensibus prodere, sed sunt strangulati.
Ann. M.DC.III.M.DC.IIII. Meutinenses respondent ad literas proscriptorias, & suam causam tuentur multis exemplis.
Tres naues auro onustæ ex India Mittelburgum redeunt.
Hollandi cum Portugalensibus nauibus committunt prelium nauale in Indiis.
Rex Galliæ ingentem pecuniam Statibus mittit.

Regina Angliæ Elisabetha pie defuncta electus & proclamatus est Rex Angliæ, Galliæ & Irlandiæ serenissimus Iacobus VI. Rex Scotiæ, vt qui à Margaretha filia Henrici VII. Regis Angliæ, Galliæ & Irlandiæ genus trahit, quæ Margaretha prognata est ex Elisabetha Regis Eduardi IV. filia, &c. Nomina dominorum in hac proclamatione præsentium vide alibi, quæ proclamatio facta est die 24. Martii An. 1603.
Capitaneus Grauendonk multos Statenses equites ad Kempen cædit.
Meutinantes ab Aquensibus & Iuliacensibus exigunt contributiones.
Statenses equites cædunt Henrici Bergensi. Equites, April.
Hispani Ostendanis tres munitiones adimunt, & ex erecta munitione valde lædunt obsessos.
Ordines mittunt Comitem Ernestum ad muniendum Rheinberg, ne Albertus suas copias eo mittat.
Regina Angliæ defuncta splendidissime sepelitur in præsentia 5. M. hominum, legauit illa pro anubus vetulis 500. flor. annuas pensiones.
Friderici Spinolæ & Statuum grauis & periculosa navalis pugna ante Ostendam, in qua occumbit Spinola, Iunii.
Iacobus VI. R. Scotiæ coronatur in Regem Angliæ die 25. Iul.

page.notes: Marginal year note "Ann. M.DC.III." at left. Page is a running text page with a catchword-like word "Pestis" at the lower right, which is a catchword and is placed in the text end. Some letters are blurred by staining; "Bergensi." and "navalis" (printed "naualis") are as printed or approximate.
